page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring no hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It contains no GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying processor lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA_NI). This absence of vector and matrix extensions limits its efficiency for mathematical modeling, cryptography, and machine learning workloads.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a modest 4.0 GB memory footprint, this instance offers an entry-level compute-focused profile. It is suitable for lightweight, non-vectorized workloads such as basic web serving, small utility applications, and simple task queues that require dedicated CPU execution without high memory or local storage demands.
